reviews.comment: Easy class. Cheat sheet allowed for exams
This professor posts her slides prior to class because she does teach pretty fast. However, attendance is still required because she does daily attendance questions for a grade.

Professor Zhang is a nice professor and is very passionate about what she does. Her extra credit is 100% worth it. You can get up to 5 points added to your overall grade which is what boosted me to an A. Her lectures can be hard to follow but try to take good notes and you'll pass the tests as long as you study hard.

Great class to take for science credit. Said on the first day that almost 85% of her students make an A, probably because of her grading criteria. Her exams are only worth 10% of your grade, so you can bomb one and still have an A as long as you do the homework, show up to class and check in on iClicker

You can tell she is clearly passionate about what she's is teaching. Never understood any of it. Double sided cheat sheet allowed for all exams. She drops an exam, and some from other categories. Weekly quizzes are multiple choice with 4 attempts. You also watch a movie.

super easy class and easy prof. group projects and one weekly homework. attendance is mandatory but its a couple of iclickers at begining of class so if you need to leave early you can. you get a one pager for each test and she drops the lowest test. if you need a science credit take this class \.

She is a good teacher, but her exams can be challenging since they're all very detail-oriented application-based questions. There's an extra credit assignment in the syllabus worth 3 overall final grade points. Other work besides exams is easy. You can bring a cheat sheet to the exams, and they end up getting curved by at least 5 points.

Easy science credit. One weekly homework and group assignments that are very easy and can be completed without meeting. Her tests can be difficult, but she lets you bring a cheat sheet. This class was amazing and an easy A if you study for the exams. She does do Iclicker so attendance does matter.

I took this class because people claimed it was an easy science credit, which was not the case. Nothing against Dr. Zhang really, she is passionate about what she teaches for sure, but if you are like me and not really interested in Geology I would avoid it. She goes really in depth which can make tests tricky.

The most caring and nicest professor I've had so far. Weekly homework assignments and 3 group projects. 4 non-cumulative exams can be tricky, but she ends up curving them. She wants everyone in her class to do well to the point that around 80% of students from past semesters made an A in the class. Uses iClicker for attendance and in-class quizzes.

Her lectures are never dull because she is super passionate about the subject. She does have iClicker, so attendance is technically mandated. The grade is super distributed, so if you do bad on midterm you'll be okay. There are various extra credit opportunities, so make sure to fully take advantage of them!

Participation is very much encouraged due to IClicker, but very easy! You can have "cheat sheet" of notes on the exam. She will tell you what to expect on the exams & drops the lowest mid term exam out of the three you will take. She's very euthanasic with her lectures and I honestly find it cool learning about many of these topics.

She's easy to understand. Participation is encouraged. She allows you to bring to exams a "cheat sheet" of notes. She tells you what to expect on the exams: both the format and the topics. She likes it when you tell her about any other resources you know about.

Professor Zhang was an amazing professor who truly cared about Geology and the students she taught.  She drops the lowest test grade and gives extra credit.  It is not hard to succeed in this class, and I enjoyed the class.  The group projects are very simple, but make sure to put your name on it, or she will not give you any credit.

Great prof who is caring & respectful to each student! 3 group activities, 3 exams + 1 final, 1 weekly quiz, and iclicker each class. Go over a powerpoint each class & which gives you insight to what is on her exams, but you will also have to know other geology terms. I got the textbook, but rarely read it. Take this class and this prof!
